name: IC 776 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 776, a dwarf galaxy in the Virgo cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic776-hubble
story: A ragged, disturbed disk seems to spiral around the core of this small galaxy, traced by arcs of star-forming regions. As it travels through the Virgo cluster, it feels the pressure of the intergalactic gas around it.

claims.text: IC 776 is in the Virgo galaxy cluster
IC 776 is an SAB-type or weakly barred spiral
IC 776 has a ragged, disturbed disc spiraling around the core, with arcs of star-forming regions
Dwarf galaxies like IC 776 traveling through the Virgo cluster experience pressure from the intergalactic gas
IC 776 is a target of program 17240 on Virgo dwarfs in stripping
